description: This is a Java interface defining methods for adding images to a CMS content module, specifically for a merchant store. It declares methods for adding a single image and multiple images, both potentially throwing ServiceException.

classes.name: ImagePut
classes.description: A Java interface for image upload operations related to CMS content in a merchant store context.

methods.name: addImage
methods.description: Adds a single image for a specified merchant store, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: addImages
methods.description: Adds multiple images for a specified merchant store, potentially throwing a ServiceException.
